subject: maths
question: A circular pipe has an external diameter of 42 cm and an internal diameter of 36 cm . Find the area of the cross-section of the pipe.
solution:
**Given:**

External diameter = 42 cm ⇒ R = 21 cm

Internal diameter = 36 cm ⇒ r = 18 cm

**Formula used:**

Area = π(R² − r²)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = 3.1416 × (21² − 18²)

⇒ = 3.1416 × (441 − 324)

⇒ = 3.1416 × 117

⇒ = 367.57 cm²

**∴ Area = 367.57 cm².**
